title: Women in Action: A Multicomponent Intervention for Older Women
official: "Women in Action": A Multicomponent Gender-Sensitive Intervention Combining Nutrition, Psychosocial Factors, and Strength Training in Perimenopausal, Menopausal, and Early-Aging Women-A Quasi-Experimental Study Protocol
summary: "Women in Action" is a quasi-experimental, mixed-methods study evaluating a 16-week multicomponent intervention (supervised strength/aerobic/balance training plus psychoeducational and nutrition-focused behavioral workshops) for women aged 55-75 in perimenopause, menopause, and early ageing. The study will assess the feasibility, implementation fidelity, and acceptability of the program, together with its preliminary effects on a single primary outcome (handgrip strength) and secondary physical function, dietary, and psychosocial outcomes, compared with a passive control group receiving no intervention.

interventions.name: Multicomponent exercise, nutrition, and psychoeducational program

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Aged 55-75 years
* Residing in the Principality of Asturias, Spain
* Written informed consent
* Medical clearance for supervised moderate-to-vigorous physical activity
* Suboptimal physical activity level (not meeting WHO recommendations of ≥150 min/week moderate or ≥75 min/week vigorous aerobic activity and/or \<2 muscle-strengthening sessions/week, and/or low adherence to prior exercise routines), screened via the Global Physical Activity Questionnaire (GPAQ)
* Relevant exposure to gender-related stereotypes associated with physical activity
* Willingness to complete all assessment phases (T0-T3)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Medical conditions contraindicating supervised exercise
* Severe cognitive impairment limiting program participation
* Concurrent involvement in structured resistance-training interventions
* Any physical or functional condition precluding safe execution of physical performance assessments (handgrip strength, SPPB)
